# Modern Treasury (Modern Treasury Corp.)

Modern Treasury is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Modern Treasury provides payment operations built for the instant economy, with faster payments, smart workflows, and real-time visibility powered by ai. Modern Treasury employs 88 people and has an annual revenue of $74.5M, founded in 2018. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Spain. Has $183M in total funding, with 5 prior funding rounds.

## About

Modern Treasury provides the most trusted infrastructure for global money movement. Trusted by leading enterprises and financial institutions, the platform helps businesses launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months, with best-in-class developer tools and a single API for both fiat and stablecoin transactions. With built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting, Modern Treasury enables instant, reliable, and scalable money movement for companies of all sizes.

Backed by leading investors including Benchmark, Altimeter, and Salesforce Ventures, Modern Treasury has powered over $400 billion in payments for hundreds of organizations.

# Why Modern Treasury Was Built

- Channel: Sam Boboev
- Length: 00:49
- Views: 129
- Likes: 0
- Published: 2026-03-01T02:00:00-08:00
- Category: People & Blogs
- Language: en

## Description

In this clip from my podcast with Modern Treasury, co-founder Matt Marcus explains the real problem they set out to solve.

Before starting the company, the founders experienced firsthand how painful money movement was inside a mortgage lender — wires for loan funding, ACH for servicing, manual processes across banks.

Their conclusion: bank payments infrastructure was broken.

Modern Treasury was built as an API-first platform to simplify ACH, wires, and checks for fintechs, marketplaces, and any company embedding payments into their product.

This is about turning fragmented bank rails into scalable infrastructure.

#fintech #payments #banking

So, think like ah and wires and checks. Modern Treasury takes a proactive approach to test our systems. One important aspect of this approach is regular third-party penetration testing. This process involves simulating real-world attacks on our systems by penetration testers to identify and address any potential vulnerabilities.

We make sure that our testing providers are industry-leading, meaning that they have a team of experts with the necessary knowledge, experience, and tools to conduct a thorough and comprehensive testing. [...] ### Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

#### Comprehensive Scanning

Modern Treasury performs comprehensive scanning during our application development process to check our products for any vulnerabilities. Our testing includes a combination of static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and software composition analysis (SCA). [...] Our team works closely with these security professionals to simulate various types of attacks and identify any weaknesses in our systems.
